payload.value:
Split out of FR-42. FR-42 covered every growth-prone runtime *cache/log* table (idempotency_keys, devtools_events, platform_events, and now expired auth_sessions). The durable stream-store (the event log) was deliberately left out: stream events are source-of-truth application data, not a cache, so a blanket age/size prune would silently destroy history.

This story designs + ships a SAFE retention model for streams:
- Opt-in per-stream retention policy (e.g. schema-declared maxAge / maxEvents, or 'ephemeral' streams) rather than a global blanket prune.
- Respect subscriber cursors / snapshots so pruning never strands an in-flight catch-up.
- Coordinate with backup/restore + Postgres parity (FR-25/FR-119).
- Tests: retained streams keep history; ephemeral/capped streams prune; cursor-safe.
